title: sister_wedding_seating_chart
beats: My sister (31F) asked me (28F) to be maid of honor, and I said yes before she finished the sentence.
The catch: her fiance's ex-girlfriend was invited, seated at MY table, because 'they're still close friends.'
I asked to be moved. My sister said I was 'making it weird' and 'ruining her vision.'
So I quietly requested the venue swap two place cards. Nothing crazy, just me next to my boyfriend instead.
My sister found out during the rehearsal dinner and lost it in front of both families.
Turns out the ex wasn't just 'a friend' -- she was the reason my sister's fiance was on a break when they met.
My sister knew this. She invited her anyway to prove she wasn't 'threatened.'
I didn't know that part when I moved my seat. I just didn't want to make small talk with a stranger all night.
Now my sister says I embarrassed her and 'planted doubt' three days before her wedding.
My mom says I should've just sucked it up, it's one dinner.
My boyfriend says the ex shouldn't have been invited in the first place, full stop.
The fiance hasn't spoken to anyone since the rehearsal dinner ended in tears.
My sister texted me at 1am: 'If you loved me you'd have just sat there.'
I texted back that I didn't sign up to be a prop in her point-proving.
Now she's asking if I'll still be maid of honor tomorrow, and I genuinely don't know what to say.
